mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.08% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.08%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 225 indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 225.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5% and employment growth (PAYEMS) is below 100,000 persons per month, the labor market is weak, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS < 100000.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (defined by UNRATE > 5%), housing starts (HOUST) below 650 units indicate weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5% and HOUST < 650.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 650 units indicate weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 650.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 650 and retail sales (RSAFS) are below 400,000 million dollars, weak consumer demand leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 650 and RSAFS < 400000.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8% indicates a severe labor market downturn, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8%.
